story.title: The Bat That Walked the Forest Trails

sentences.text: The lone hunter walked deeper into the thick woods while a single crow stared silently from a bare branch.
Old stories from the mountain villages tell of ancient shapeshifters who leave their human skin hidden beneath floorboards.
Fresh heavy footprints appeared in the mud right beside his own muddy boots.
He paused to listen as heavy breathing drifted down from the canopy above.
The dark shape dropped from the branches and rushed forward with terrifying speed.
A sharp cry echoed through the trees before cutting off into sudden silence.
Only a discarded hunting knife lay gleaming on the cold dirt pathway.
Could you survive a night in the woods when something is hunting your footsteps?
